title: Tiếng Việt trong kinh tế và kinh doanh 1

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop proficiency in Vietnamese language, including vocabulary, grammar, and economic terminology.
Improve communication skills in Vietnamese, including listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
Enhance critical thinking and problem-solving skills in a language context.
Develop teamwork and collaboration skills in language learning activities.
Learn to effectively search and utilize information related to economic and business topics.
Improve skills in delivering prepared and impromptu presentations in Vietnamese.
Enhance writing skills in Vietnamese, including structuring and grammar.
